local_news.headline: Stinky river crisis: San Diego County approves $1 billion to treat Tijuana River sewage
local_news.summary: Sewage from Tijuana flows into Imperial Beach, Coronado and other parts of southern San Diego County, sickening swimmers and surfers and forcing beach closures.

local_news.headline: Imperial Beach shoreline closed due to sewage contamination
local_news.summary: The Imperial Beach shoreline was closed to human contact Sunday by county health officials due to sewage contamination.

local_news.headline: Report a Stranding in San Diego County
local_news.summary: How to report an injured, stranded, or dead marine mammal including whales, dolphins, porpoises, seals, and sea lions.

local_news.headline: A marine heat wave caused seabird deaths off California. El Nino could worsen the die-off
local_news.summary: Record ocean heat and El Nino are leading to mass California seabird die-offs.
